observations: Black rectangular console with visible PlayStation logo on front.
Two grey DualShock controllers in front of console.
Console has visible scratches and scuffs on top and sides.
Console placed on blue plastic chair with visible wear.
Watermark 'PHOTO TAKEN ON 11' and 'MICHAEL JEREMIAH' on image.

claims.claim: PS4 Fat Double Pad Good Condition
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows console and controllers, but condition claims not verifiable from photos alone.

risks.risk: Console may be damaged internally or have software issues.
risks.proof: Internal inspection or boot test of console.

risks.risk: Controllers may have unreported damage or dead batteries.
risks.proof: Test of both controllers for full functionality.

risks.risk: Console may be counterfeit or not genuine PlayStation 4.
risks.proof: Check for official PlayStation 4 serial number and authenticity sticker.

proof_requests: Request for serial number and authenticity sticker on console.
Request for video showing console booting and controllers working.
Request for close-up photos of all ports and buttons on console and controllers.
response.reason: The photos show visible wear on the console and controllers, but cannot verify the 'good condition' claim or confirm authenticity. Critical risks like internal damage or counterfeit status require proof before pricing.
